name: hud
description: Routes each request to the cheapest capable Claude model, and shows model, context and quota above the prompt

routing.title: Route by task
routing.description: Pick the model for each request from what the prompt asks for. Turn this off to leave the model alone and keep only the readout.

fast_model.title: Model for small work
fast_model.description: Used for typo fixes, renames and other one-file edits.

base_model.title: Model for everyday work
base_model.description: Used when a prompt is neither trivial nor a planning job.

deep_model.title: Model for planning and hard problems
deep_model.description: Used for planning, design, refactors and debugging.

top_model.title: Model for whole-system work
top_model.description: The flagship model, for a brief that covers an entire system or where being wrong is expensive. Leave empty to never route here automatically.

route_to_top.title: Route up to the flagship model
route_to_top.description: Off leaves the flagship model out of automatic routing. You can still choose it yourself with /model.

spare_quota_above.title: Stop routing up at
spare_quota_above.description: Percent of the five-hour window at which the deep model is no longer chosen automatically. Set to 100 to never hold back.

bar_cells.title: Bar width
bar_cells.description: How many characters wide each bar is. Ten gives a clean ten percent per block.

ascii.title: Plain characters only
ascii.description: Draw the bars and separators with ASCII, for a terminal that is not in UTF-8.
